description: Source code for bot navigation and pathfinding functions in a game, including route calculation, waypoint finding, and polygon boundary checks.

methods.name: BotCalcSteerDir
methods.description: Calculates steering direction based on corner vertices and current position.

methods.name: FindWaypoints
methods.description: Finds corner waypoints along a bot's path.

methods.name: PointInPolyExtents
methods.description: Checks if a point is within polygon extents, considering boundary proximity.

methods.name: PointInPoly
methods.description: Checks if a point is within a polygon, using the bot's entity extents.

methods.name: BotFindNearestPoly
methods.description: Finds the nearest navigation polygon to a coordinate.

methods.name: InvalidateRouteResults
methods.description: Invalidates cached route results based on time and validity.

methods.name: FindRoute
methods.description: Calculates a navigation route for a bot to a target position.
